en: This postcard shows a historical town square, as labeled 'Marktplatz,' featuring a central baroque column adorned with statues. Surrounding the square are ornate multi-story buildings characteristic of Central European architecture, along with a church and other classic civic structures. The image is in black and white, suggesting it is from the early 20th century or earlier.
